# appdynamics_database_agent_events (Data Source)

Queries Database Monitoring agent events (account-wide) within a time range. Like appdynamics_events, this is a reporting/lookup query over historical data, not a list of currently-managed config objects -- results change over time as new events occur.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "appdynamics_database_agent_events" "recent_critical" {
  time_range_type  = "BEFORE_NOW"
  duration_in_mins = 1440
  event_types      = ["POLICY_CONTINUES_CRITICAL", "POLICY_OPEN_CRITICAL"]
  severities       = ["ERROR", "WARN"]
}

output "recent_critical_events" {
  value = data.appdynamics_database_agent_events.recent_critical.events
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `event_types` (List of String) Event types to include, e.g. ["POLICY_CONTINUES_CRITICAL"] (verified live: required -- the API rejects the request with "event-types is not specified" if omitted).
- `severities` (List of String) Severities to include, e.g. ["INFO", "WARN", "ERROR"] (verified live: required, same as event_types).
- `time_range_type` (String) BEFORE_NOW, AFTER_TIME, or BETWEEN_TIMES.

### Optional

- `duration_in_mins` (Number) Required when time_range_type is BEFORE_NOW or AFTER_TIME.
- `end_time` (Number) Epoch milliseconds. Required when time_range_type is BETWEEN_TIMES.
- `start_time` (Number) Epoch milliseconds. Required when time_range_type is BETWEEN_TIMES or AFTER_TIME.

### Read-Only

- `events` (Attributes List) The events matching the query. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--events))

<a id="nestedatt--events"></a>
### Nested Schema for `events`

Read-Only:

- `deep_link_url` (String)
- `event_time` (Number) Epoch milliseconds.
- `id` (String)
- `severity` (String)
- `sub_type` (String)
- `summary` (String)
- `type` (String)
